title: Deleting an Object from the Entra ID Object Safelist

blocks.text: You can delete an Entra ID object that is marked safe from the Entra ID Object Safelist.
To delete an Entra ID object from the safelist:

blocks.item: Go to ITDR > Settings > Entra ID Object Safelist.
Select a tenant from the Result for drop-down menu.
Under Actions, click the Delete icon to remove the object from the safelist.
In the confirmation window, click OK.
When you remove an object from the safelist, it gets added to the Focus Areas page and the new and previous vulnerability reports for the selected issue.
